responsibility: Implements the main FR-V target backend in C++, covering ABI and frame layout logic, prologue/epilogue expansion, address legitimacy and reload support, operand and move expansion, branch/condition-code handling, conditional execution and if-conversion customization, VLIW scheduling/packetization support, builtin definition and expansion for media and I/O instructions, small-data/PIC/FDPIC/TLS code generation, asm output helpers, cost modeling, and the target-hook glue that connects the FR-V machine description to GCC’s middle and RTL back ends.
same_name_distinction: C++ implementation file for the FR-V port: it provides the executable target-hook logic and helper routines that use the declarations and macros from frv.h, drive recognition/expansion of patterns defined in frv.md, and consume option state defined through frv.opt.
